g.text: The 2×4 frame went up over the weekend. Corners are braced
with 45° gussets; the ridge beam is a single 12' piece.
☐ run the drip line from the rain barrel
Twin-wall polycarbonate, 8 mm. Order from the supplier in
, not the big-box store: the UV coating is on one
side only and theirs is labelled.
